text:
A is better. It stays under the 120-word limit (about 115 words by my count) and is easy for a busy manager to scan. It covers every section of the release notes without padding.

B is roughly twice the word limit, so it breaks the main constraint. It also adds filler, such as the opening thank-you and the description of its own structure. Its closing line, "no action is required from the team," isn't supported by the source text.

**A**
